positive_terms: Total amount of substances of concern that are generated or used during production or that are procured, breakdown by main hazard classes of substances of concern
关注物质按危害类别分解的披露结构

Total amount of substances of concern that are generated or used during production or that are procured, breakdown by main hazard classes of substances of concern。关注物质按危害类别分解的披露结构。以物质或危害类别、关注/高度关注分类、生成/使用/采购或离开设施流向、期间与设施范围区分。分类不是同义词，重叠输入不能盲目求和；总量与明细不可重复计数。
